subject.title: perf(gateway): bound session list title probes to transcript head and tail

question: Should session listings be allowed to omit previously derivable titles or previews for long but valid transcripts in exchange for a fixed per-session probe cap?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes a visible derived-data contract on cap misses; code review cannot decide whether that degradation is acceptable for existing clients.

options.title: Preserve existing output
options.body: Require a correctness-preserving bounded store query or targeted fallback so valid transcripts keep their derived title and preview.

options.title: Accept capped derivation
options.body: Document and approve the intentional behavior that sessions outside the probe window may have no derived title or preview.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing output
recommendation.body: Require a correctness-preserving bounded store query or targeted fallback so valid transcripts keep their derived title and preview.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent gateway work and the production performance investigation make this the best available routing candidate, though exact ownership history remains unverified.
